messages.text:
I have enough of the option and renderer contracts to patch now.

The main equivalence risk is not help/version text; it is sorting, hidden entries, Windows long-permission columns, and tree connector state, so the implementation will keep those as explicit reusable code paths and keep oracle probes out of runtime.
